description: SOL escrow and agent registry from reddi-agent-protocol, on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.1.2). register_agent burns a 0.01 SOL fee to the incinerator; lock_escrow and release_escrow were verified end-to-end (payee received 1_000_000 lamports, PDA closed). Token escrow, ratings and Quasar/PER were not exercised.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of programs/escrow from nissan/reddi-agent-protocol. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/reddi-escrow-solana (8448b8a plus declare_id). Blockchains/reddi-agent-protocol already existed and its default branch had diverged. The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (register_agent, lock_escrow, release_escrow)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/reddi-escrow/
QA: devnet proof of register_agent, lock_escrow, release_escrow, ModelTooLong, and ZeroAmount
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise lock_token_escrow / release_token_escrow with the lab SPL mint
